sentences.text: Shri Durgesh Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant.
Ms. Bharti Lakkad, learned counsel for the respondent/State.
The revision is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on IA No.28553/2021, which is an application for suspension of sentence filed by applicant Jitendra Singh Dangi.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been convicted under Section 7(1) read with Section 16(1)
(a)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to six months R.I. with fine.
He further submits that the applicant has remained on bail during trial and he did not misuse the liberty granted to him and that final conclusion of this revision will take long sufficient time.
Hence he prays for grant of bail and suspension of sentence.
Per-contra, learned PL for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

After considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties, nature and gravity of the allegation against the applicant and also taking note of the fact that during trial applicant was on bail and he did not misuse the liberty of bail given to him and that final conclusion of this revision will take long sufficient time, I deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the applicant.

Accordingly, IA No.28553/2021 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the applicant is hereby suspended till the final disposal of Jitendra Singh Dangi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170526315/

with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 24.1.2022 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this revision.
List for final hearing in due course.
